title: Hakoniwa A-2 sensor manifest
description: Declares which mujoco-sensor sensors a robot (e.g. a drone) uses. Consumed by hakoniwa-mujoco-sensor SensorRuntime (include/runtime/sensor_runtime.hpp).

pdu_robot.description: Default PDU channel robot/owner for all components.

env.description: Optional env.xml reference (the runtime also accepts env via its constructor).

kind.description: Only 'sensor' entries are instantiated by the A-2 runtime; others are skipped.

type.description: Sensor type key. Types known to the A-2 runtime: lidar_3d, lidar_2d, radar (unknown types are skipped).

mount.description: Sensor mounting relative to the robot body (offset rotated by base yaw; yaw added).
